title: Knotted Crunchy Australian Bread Toast
description: A cozy Australian dish featuring stale bread, perfect for a snack or light meal, this recipe is dairy-free-friendly and offers a salty, aerated taste experience.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the stale bread into 1-inch thick slices and then cut each slice into a knotted shape.
Submerge the knotted bread slices in an ice bath for 30 seconds to shock them.
Remove the bread from the ice bath and place it on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the olive oil over the bread and sprinkle with salt, sesame seeds, and paprika.
Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 15 minutes, or until it is crunchy and golden brown.
Remove the bread from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the knotted crunchy Australian bread toast warm and enjoy.
